nodes.long_description:
1. Place 2 cucumbers on a cutting board.
2. Cut the cucumbers with a paring knife and transfer the cuts to a pickling jar.
3. Fill a saucepan with water and add the sugar, salt, and pepper.
4. Turn on the stove and bring to a boil over medium heat until the sugar and salt dissolve.
5. when the sugar and salt are dissolved, turn off the stove and add the vinegar to the pot
6. Pour the sauce into the pickle jars, put the lids on, and you're done.
nodes.short_description: Learn how to make cucumber pickles in virtual reality and understand the interesting scientific phenomena behind the process.

Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
